name: Joseph Coe
role: Early elder and Kirtland high councilor
dateNote: Section 55 sent him to Missouri in June 1831, and section 102 lists him on the first high council in February 1834.
importance: Joseph Coe, a New York farmer, joined in 1831; section 55 sends him to Missouri with Joseph Smith and Sidney Rigdon. Section 102 names him to the first Kirtland high council in 1834. In 1835 he paid a third of the price of the Egyptian mummies and papyri. He was excommunicated in December 1837.
connections: He travelled with Joseph Smith, Sidney Rigdon, and William W. Phelps in 1831.

sources.title: Joseph Coe, Joseph Smith Papers biography
